# GT Marketing

> GT Marketing is a Darwin-based Australian marketing and communications business that prioritises Aboriginal organisations, community-led enterprises and regional organisations. It supports work across the Top End, Central Australia and wider Australia through remote delivery, scheduled regional visits and project-specific travel arrangements.

## Priority sector

- Aboriginal organisations: https://gtmarketing.io/aboriginal-organisations
- Top End coverage: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/top-end
- Central Australia coverage: https://gtmarketing.io/locations/central-australia

GT Marketing works with Aboriginal corporations, art centres, ranger groups, community stores, community-controlled health and community-service organisations, cultural tourism enterprises and other community-led organisations.

Relevant support can include organisational communications, grant and funding narratives, capability statements, business plans, reporting structures, digital presence, tourism and arts storytelling, e-commerce or booking journeys, low-bandwidth delivery and remote project support.

GT Marketing does not guarantee grant or funding outcomes. Organisations retain responsibility for eligibility and final submissions.

## Cultural authority and ICIP

GT Marketing does not claim authority over Aboriginal culture, stories, language, images or community knowledge. Where culturally sensitive material is involved, the client identifies the appropriate authority and approval process.

Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property considerations are discussed for relevant projects. Client-supplied cultural material is used only for the agreed purpose and subject to the agreed approval pathway.

GT Marketing is not Aboriginal-owned and does not claim endorsement by Aboriginal organisations or communities unless a specific relationship has been authorised for publication.

## Regional delivery

### Top End

GT Marketing is physically based in Darwin City and serves the Top End as a regional service area. Remote collaboration, low-bandwidth review methods, regional visits and on-Country support can be arranged where useful and appropriate.

### Central Australia

Central Australia is a remote service region, not a GT Marketing office location. Work can be delivered remotely with travel by arrangement.

### Darwin City, Casuarina and Palmerston

GT Marketing retains its Darwin City physical address and continues to serve Casuarina and Palmerston as genuine service areas.
